replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived promoter state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in Drosophila promoters (n = 5912 promoters).
outputs.explanation: The panel reports median state frequencies computed across a defined set of promoters, with both the number (n = 5912) and type (promoters) explicitly stated in the caption.
The panel shows single-molecule sorting with frequency percentages derived from 2952 molecules, and this number and type (molecules) are directly stated on the panel image.
